_comment: Hand-curated name -> id overrides for the link resolver in scripts/build_companies.py.
This file exists for the cases automation should NOT decide on its own:
* a firm whose common press name has no textual overlap with its listed name
("Andreessen Horowitz" -> the a16z Bio + Health vehicle),
* a rename where old and new names share nothing ("Sequoia Capital India" -> Peak XV),
* a genuine ambiguity that region cannot break.
It does NOT exist for ambiguity region already handles — OrbiMed, Lightstone and
SV Health run a separate vehicle per geography, and the resolver picks the one
matching the company's region. Adding those here would override a correct answer.
Keys are matched after normalization (case, punctuation and legal suffixes are
already ignored), so one entry covers 'a16z bio+health' and 'A16Z Bio + Health'.
A key pointing at an id that no longer exists is reported as 'alias-dangling'

_comment_ambiguity: Below: names the resolver correctly refused because they matched more
than one record and region could not break the tie. Each is a judgement
about which record a press release means by the bare name.
RH Capital rebranded to Foreground Capital in 2024 and the same team
still manages RH Capital Funds I and II — one continuing firm held as two
records. This alias points links at the surviving name; deduplicating the
two records themselves is a data fix, not a linking fix, and belongs in
Illumina Accelerator and Illumina Ventures are genuinely different
vehicles; a cap table saying just 'Illumina' means the venture fund.
IP Group plc is the UK parent; the Australian entity is its subsidiary.
